securityIncident.title: SAM.gov API key briefly exposed in conversation transcript via unredacted error message
securityIncident.whatHappened: GovernedHttpClient's thrown error messages embedded the full request URL, including the api_key query parameter, for any failed request. When a scratch debug script's Gap array (containing these error messages) was displayed via a Bash `cat` of its output file, the SAM.gov key appeared in plaintext in the conversation transcript twice.
verifiedNotExposedTo: repository files (git grep across all tracked and untracked files: 0 matches)
any exported UI artifact (organizationCrosswalk.js never reads the Gaps array)
exposedTo: one temp scratchpad log file (deleted immediately upon discovery)
securityIncident.fix: xenodroid-bw/src/atoms/GovernedHttpClient.ts now exports RedactCredentialedUri, which strips api_key/apikey/key/token/access_token query parameters from any URL — whole-string or embedded in arbitrary error text — before it can reach an error message, Gap reason, log line, or export. Applied at every throw site and the finalUri return in FetchJson. A regression test is wired into `npm run bw:test` (cli.ts cmdTestOffline) asserting redaction on both a full URL and a URL embedded in error text.
securityIncident.recommendation: Director should consider rotating the SAM.gov key out of caution, since it appeared in this session's conversation transcript even though it never touched any persisted repo/database/export artifact.
securityIncident.reGateVerification: Full bw:gate re-run after the fix, output redirected to a local file and grepped for "api_key" before any display: 0 matches. Gate passed cleanly.
